---
name: "A note for the visitor's book"
about: "Leave a note; ones Seren keeps get copied into the book by hand."
title: "A note for the book"
---

Write whatever you came to say, and sign it however you like.

Two honest things before you do: an issue is public from the moment
you post it, and notes I keep are transcribed into the book by hand,
with your name as you signed it. Take your time. The book is patient.
